Your app cannot email anyone yet. One address fixes it.

Hercules
Your software needs one quick thing. Right now it cannot:

* Send an invoice to a customer
* Confirm a booking
* Reset a password for somebody locked out of the app you built them

None of that can send yet. Email needs one verified sending address, and your app does not have one.

The failure is silent, which is why it is easy to miss. Nothing bounces back to you. The app looks fine from where you are sitting. The only person who finds out is the one waiting.

Verifying one address turns all of it on at once. No third-party account, no API key, nothing else to wire up, and it is free on every plan.
